description: Six exploratory recovery questions over previously explored sources; one repeats the prior rejected case. Not independent held-out evidence.

tasks.query: Propose a source-backed plan to reconcile a synthetic conflicting retry-limit claim with its original document.
Propose a review plan for a finding whose cited document was revised after the finding was written.
Propose how a retrieval agent can continue when a document source is missing, while identifying the missing evidence.
Propose checks for an agent claim that lacks supporting source evidence.
Propose how two agent roles can prioritize shared source passages without treating usefulness scores as truth.
Propose tests for a source-linked context packet that must fit a fixed size limit.
